description: Where FEMA's Public Assistance (rebuilding) money for Puerto Rico has been committed, from 787daily's Recovery Money Tracker, read weekly from FEMA's OpenFEMA data: the island total since 2001, FEMA's categories (utilities, public buildings, roads and bridges …), each disaster, the island-wide agencies (PREPA, AAA, Education …), the projects newly obligated since the last weekly read and every town's total and money per resident. `town` gives one town's largest projects and rank; `agency` one island-wide applicant. The money is OBLIGATED (committed to approved projects), not spent: say so. `paidOut` is what COR3, Puerto Rico's recovery office, has actually paid out, from its transparency portal: with no argument island-wide, by disaster, by agency and by quarter; with `town` or `agency`, that one's figures and largest projects. Each carries its own committedUsd and pctPaid: state a % only from those (FEMA's obligatedUsd is a different list). A town's FEMA total is the projects filed under it; island-wide agencies' projects are in no town. `treasuryOutlays` is a partial cross-check; `housingGrantsHud` HUD's separate housing grants. Cite 787daily.com/recovery/, FEMA and COR3.

agency.description: An island-wide applicant, e.g. 'PREPA', 'AAA' or 'Department of Education'

town.description: A municipio name or slug, e.g. 'Utuado' or 'juana-diaz'

name: get_recovery_money
title: FEMA recovery money by town
